review.brief_reason: The only change is in the log argument: (sqrt(A) + y3)/A was rewritten as 1/sqrt(A) + y3/A. For A > 0, sqrt(A)/A = A^(1/2)/A = A^(-1/2) = 1/sqrt(A), so the transformation is algebraically exact. Both forms require A > 0 (original: sqrt(A) with division by A; proposed: 1/sqrt(A) and y3/A), so the domain A > 0 is preserved, and the log arguments are identical on that domain. All other terms and the outer structure (-y3 + (...)/x2) are unchanged; no variables were renamed or permuted. The rewrite is marginally simpler (removes a nested numerator).
